note: Musical instruments for playing and holding poses. Counts are the whole point: every desc states the number of strings, tuning pegs, valves, holes or bridges, because the model adds or drops them. Handheld instruments use place=float shown upright (flutes vertical, headjoint or blowing end at the top); instruments that rest on the ground or lie flat (cello, snare drum, the two zithers) use place=stand. Generic designs only: no brand headstock or body outline, no logo, no case, no stand, no strap, no sheet music. The erhu bow is part of the instrument (its hair passes between the strings) and is always shown; the violin is shown with its bow by request; no other bow, plectrum or stick appears.
